notes.title: Queen's Brothel Final Release
notes.notes:
It has been 8 years since I started the journey of Queen's Brothel. Today, we are releasing the very last update.

Queen's Brothel started out as a game I really enjoyed writing for in my free time and I'm very grateful to have so many fans who enjoy the fun characters we made.

The history of Queen's Brothel will forever be a reminder of my goals for everything we produce going forward. When I had absolutely nothing, I worked tirelessly on a game not for myself, but because I wanted to make something that was free and fun for the 25 people that were enjoying it at the time. Success was only determined by how much better the next update could be.

It's finally time for a break. The ending of the game's final quest hints at each character's growth, but will leave the player confused for one character...

Queen. She has had a long journey, but has always remained a mystery. What did Queen accomplish by the end of the story? Did she get what she wanted? Instead of a sequel in the future, we'll be going backwards. Our next game in the Queen's Brothel universe will be the beautiful backstory of Queen.

Below are the quest outfits for each character. They represent their "final form".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42661076/1d07700cca9518ce88473b25974c313f0d1dc1d1.jpg[/img]

Queen - Has gained confidence and leadership skills, she's learned how to manage the other girls and become a "madam" of the brothel. Her gold jewelry gives her the mature look reminiscing, perhaps, a real queen!

Suki - Embraced going from "normal" college student to finding out she's part of a demon lineage. Her outfit is a reminder to everyone around her to not fall in love with the crazy girl.

Esxea - Embracing modernity. Her outfit shows her roots of being with her friends in the Morass Inn. She will always be a goofball, but now she knows how to be a formal goofball.

Scarlett - Has been humbled quite often. Her dress is more subtle and humble than her default outfit, while still having elegance. She no longer needs to use her beauty as a weapon for her kingdom.

Ardura - Tough, but her dress shows a softer side. She had to embrace coming out of the rugged orc lifestyle. Ardura's life was all about war and defending her friends, but she has learned to accept the differences between orcs and humans.

Natasha - Has gained confidence after breaking out of a strict elven society. Her bared-shoulders show she's comfortable with her sexuality, but the brooch symbolizes that she still has a pure heart.

I hope you enjoy.

Thank you so much for being a part of the creation of Queen's Brothel.
